summary: Authenticated browser capture and disposable live round-trips proved favorite and user-starter item add/remove writes.

multipart_field.name: operations
multipart_field.shape: binary protobuf part with Content-Type application/octet-stream

request_payload_layout.outer_message: PBStarterListOperationList with one operation in field 1
request_payload_layout.operation_metadata: PBOperationMetadata field 1; handlers bulk-add-list-items and bulk-remove-list-items
request_payload_layout.operation_list: partial StarterList in field 7 containing the identifier and one complete ListItem
request_payload_layout.item_category_fallback: browser sends categoryMatchId=other when the visible item has no category

cleanup.fixture: disposable shopping list and temporary favorite item
cleanup.fixture_removal: shopping list deleted through the verified list-delete route; favorite and starter test items removed and confirmed absent by fresh reads

gate_state: Favorite and starter add/remove mutations are enabled only with --apply and fresh read-after-write verification. Photo, price, and list-level starter mutations remain separate capabilities.
invariants_held: No raw IDs, email addresses, cookies, tokens, or captured request bodies are stored
Transport HTTP 200 alone is never reported as success
The caller's item is not mutated while building the request
Disposable data was removed before the probe ended
